title: Tumbao Conga Drift
description: A warm tuned hand-drum voice built from layered sine and triangle oscillators playing a rolling tumbao conga groove in the low-mid register. The pitch envelope drops sharply on each hit to mimic the skin-slap transient, while filter cutoff, pan, and pitch step cycle on mutually-prime LFO clocks (7, 11, 13, 17 cycles) so open and muted tones drift through new combinations over ~30 seconds before repeating. Over the full arc the tone morphs from warm and round to snappier and brighter, then settles back — an organic, breathing conga that never sits still.
code:
setcpm(96/4)
stack(
  note("<c2 c2 eb2 c2> [c2 g2] <c2 bb1> [c2 c2 eb2 g2]")
    .s("sine")
    .penv("<7 7 12 4>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.12)
    .lpf(sine.slow(11).range(300, 1800)).resonance(sine.slow(7).range(2, 9))
    .lpenv(sine.slow(13).range(1, 5)).lpdecay(0.18)
    .gain("<1 0.6 1 0.5 1 0.75 1 0.55>/1".slow(2))
    .attack(0.001).decay("<0.18 0.14 0.22 0.12>/8").sustain(0).release(0.05)
    .shape(sine.slow(17).range(0.1, 0.45))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.25, 0.75))
    .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).pan(0.15))
    .room(0.18)
    .postgain(0.9)
    .gain(0.92)
  ,
  note("<c2 c2 eb2 c2> [c2 g2] <c2 bb1> [c2 c2 eb2 g2]")
    .s("triangle")
    .penv("<5 5 9 3>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.08)
    .lpf(sine.slow(13).range(200, 900))
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.1).sustain(0).release(0.03)
    .shape(0.25)
    .gain(0.35)
    .room(0.1)
)
